components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-panel { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); } .ds-panel-heading { min-height: 51px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e9eef5; } .ds-panel-heading h2 { margin: 0; color: #293b55; font: 680 13px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-heading p { margin: 3px 0 0; color: #687991; font: 400 10px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 15px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pairs a short state label with a restrained semantic tint.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font: 700 9px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status--blue { border-color: #dce7fb; background: #edf3ff; color: #2459b2; } .ds-status--green { border-color: #d8efe3; background: var(--green-pale); color: var(--green); } .ds-status--amber { border-color: #f4e5bb; background: var(--amber-pale); color: var(--amber); } .ds-status--red { border-color: #f3d7d4; background: var(--red-pale); color: var(--red); } .ds-status--gray { border-color: #e0e6ed; background: #f4f6f8; color: #52647d; }

components.name: Mobile Room Summary
components.description: Summarizes the room, tenant, latest reading, unpaid invoices, and balance in one tap target.
components.css: .ds-room { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto 15px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #425772; text-align: left; transition: border-color .16s ease, background-color .16s ease; } .ds-room:hover, .ds-room:active { border-color: #cbdcf6; background: #f7faff; } .ds-room:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8ab5ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-room-main, .ds-room-debt { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-room-main b { color: #263950; font: 650 12px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-room-main small, .ds-room-debt small { color: #61748e; font: 400 10px/1.35 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-room-debt { justify-items: end; } .ds-room-debt b { color: #ad581d; font: 750 11px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.description: Shows invoice detail and room actions in an accessible mobile sheet.

components.css: .ds-room-sheet { position: fixed; z-index: 50; inset: auto 0 0; max-height: 80dvh; overflow: auto; padding: 15px 15px calc(15px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border: 1px solid #dce5f0; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 -12px 32px rgb(22 42 73 / 14%); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-room-sheet h2 { margin: 0; color: #293e5a; font-size: 16px; } .ds-room-sheet p { color: #667990; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-room-sheet button { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #365170; } .ds-room-sheet button:hover { background: #f8fafd; } .ds-room-sheet button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8ab5ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
StaySync's landlord workspace should feel friendly, light, and modern while giving daily work a calm, predictable rhythm. The same neutral system sans stack serves every screen; clear labels, compact rows, and repeatable table alignment carry the hierarchy instead of decorative display lettering.

Blue identifies navigation and ordinary primary actions, pale blue holds selected or contextual data, and orange marks a high-priority next step. White surfaces over a cool light ground keep long data views easy to scan. Green, amber, and red stay tied to operational status. Borders and tonal shifts separate most surfaces; a soft shadow appears only on layers that move above the page, such as mobile navigation and the room detail sheet.
keyCharacteristics: Calm blue-and-white surfaces for information-dense work.
Room, tenant, latest reading, invoice balance, and next action stay connected.
Compact labels and aligned rows make repeated tasks easy to scan.
Orange is reserved for a small number of priority actions.

rules.name: The Quiet Priority Rule
rules.body: Keep orange for the next action that deserves attention; blue remains the everyday navigation and action color.

rules.name: The Scan Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use size and weight to distinguish the task, panel, and supporting label; do not add a decorative display face.

rules.name: The Room-First Rule
rules.body: Keep the room identity and the details needed for its next action together; make mobile cards summarize the same operational facts as the desktop row.

dos: Do keep room, tenant, meter reading, invoice balance, and next action connected in the control desk.
Do reserve orange for a clearly prioritized action and use blue for everyday navigation and primary controls.
Do label each semantic status in text as well as color.
Do keep the mobile room summary readable without horizontal scrolling.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't present invented occupancy, payment, or debt figures as live data.
Don't add permanent shadows to flat panels; reserve elevation for floating layers.
Don't rely on color alone to explain an invoice or room state.
Don't make mobile users pan through a wide dashboard table to identify the next task.
